asked.item: What did the app do when I reconnected
Other channels unchecked, posts not going to them

verdict.reason: The Slack help page says reconnecting clears the channel selection and says to check every channel you want, including ones you already use.

steps.text: Reconnecting clears the workspace's channel selection, so your other channels were unchecked.
To fix it, open Accounts, open the Slack workspace's ... menu, and select Reconnect.
Check the new channel and every channel you already use, then select Finish.
